name: Amsel
description: A demon-cursed former Cathar and thief on Innistrad, adopted by Jofridus, who avenges Reika's death.

description_citations.text: "Amsel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jofridus sends Amsel to retrieve the Bloodletter; Amsel finds and kills the vampire lord Thatu Reiniger and takes it.
timeline.quote: He retrieved the cursed blade after finding and killing the vampire lord Thatu Reiniger

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Amsel and Reika are besieged by undead on the moors and shelter with necromancer Geralf Cecani.
timeline.quote: They found temporary refuge with a young man named Geralf Cecani

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reika accuses Jofridus of being a Skirsdag cultist; Jofridus murders her and tries to recruit Amsel, who flees as a heretic.
timeline.quote: Jofridus murdered Reika and tried to recruit Amsel into a demonic pact for eternal life.

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elder Adila Rimheit commands Amsel to capture Jofridus and expose him to the Lunarch.
timeline.quote: Rimheit commanded Amsel to capture Jofridus and expose his corruption to the Lunarch

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beneath Thraben Cathedral Amsel destroys a demonic manifestation of Reika and kills Jofridus with the Bloodletter.
timeline.quote: confronted Jofridus and killed him with the cursed blade

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Near death, Amsel dons the unholy yoke Jofridus had worn, giving up his humanity to survive.
timeline.quote: Amsel chose to don the unholy yoke that Jofridus had worn, sacrificing his humanity to survive

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Amsel renounces the name Raben and returns to his original name.
timeline.quote: returned to his original name, Amsel

relations.quote: before being adopted by Father Jofridus
